About KWEMPTUUL

KWEMPTUUL is the ICT and software development community initiative of Kawempe 1 Keti Falawo Crafts and Designers Group. We are expanding our community work into technology by helping youth gain relevant digital skills, confidence and experience.

What we do

Our focus is learning by doing. Activities can grow with the community while keeping practical software skills at the centre.

💻

Software Development Training

Practical learning in web, mobile and software development foundations, with an emphasis on building real projects.

👥

Youth Learning Sessions

Accessible community sessions that help beginners start, practise consistently and progress alongside their peers.

⚙️

Projects & Innovation

Collaborative projects where learners turn ideas into useful digital solutions and develop problem-solving experience.
